newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH GOVT WINS CONFIDENCE VOTE 126-54 -SPEAKER.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH GOVT WINS CONFIDENCE VOTE 126-54 -SPEAKER.

text.p: The Finnish government on Tuesday won a vote of confidence in parliament, the Speaker said.
In the vote, 126 MPs supported Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen's left-right-green coalition, 54 were against, one abstained and 18 were not present, the Speaker said.
The parliamentary groups of the five government parties control 141 seats in the 200-member single-chamber legislature.
The government had been widely expected to win the confidence vote, which followed an interpellation by the opposition Centre Party criticising the cabinet's social and regional policies.
The Lipponen coalition now won its sixth vote of confidence since taking office in April 1995.
